### How this work is cited

Passages inside Discourses and Enchiridion are identified by discourse number and section. Epictetus wrote nothing. The Discourses were transcribed and edited by his pupil Arrian, who states that he recorded what he heard and left the reasoning as it stood; the Handbook is Arrian's own selection. Attribution to Epictetus is therefore via Arrian in every case.
